explanation: Choose y₁(x)=cos(7x) and y₂(x)=sin(7x). Their derivatives give A=[[0,7],[0,−7]], so |det(A)|=0. The homogeneous BVP has infinitely many solutions y=C cos(7x). Consequently, the inhomogeneous BVP has infinitely many solutions or no solution, as stated by the lesson's classification.

answers.correct_value: has infinitely many solutions or no solution
